reviewNotes: Reviewed all 118 speech keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages33-35-selection.json. Contextual topic/contrast は, には, では and とは rendered わ; object を rendered お; directional 魚へ, 煮汁へ, 肉へ, 表面へ and 水へ rendered え. Preserved lexical はっちょう, はっこうこう, はるやさい, はいらない, きはつ, へいたん and へらす, plus connective または. Corrected exporter artifact 合わせあわせみそ to source reading あわせみそ. Checked ぎんだら, さけ, あえごろも, でんがく, こめず, とんじる, むぎこう, みそこう, のうせきかっしょく and regional names against explicit readings. Loanwords rendered in hiragana retaining long-vowel marks; 30分 rendered さんじゅっぷん; pairing equals signs rendered spoken topic わ with pauses. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
